messages:
zoe-logistics: Heads-up: AWB 620-3344556 stuck at FRA broker, manifest NACKs due to EDI gateway timeouts. Carrier suggests manual review, ETA +20h. We have 9 priority H100s that might need air-split.
prime-forwarder: Confirmed. Intermittent EDI failures at broker side caused the rejection. Clearing backlog, but manual broker processing will add ~18-24h.
zoe-logistics: Any customs paperwork gaps? last time COO mismatch caused delay.
prime-forwarder: Paperwork complete. Customs flagged a thermal spot-inspection on 3 units, requesting depot photos + serial audit.
maria-procurement: If hold >24h we should air-move 9 units FRA->LHR. Ballpark uplift?
prime-forwarder: Ballpark +€72k for 9 units next-day including uplift and brokerage. Need go-ahead by EOD CET to secure capacity.
eli-ops: Which pools are impacted? Noah, what happens to capacity if delayed 24-48h?
noah-sre: Those 9 are allocated across EU-west Dedicated burst pools and one enterprise install. 24-48h delay will raise queue latency ~30% at peak and push the install by a day. Canary scaling reduces impact but not customer cutover risk.
zoe-logistics: Important: confirm RMA continuity for split AWBs — no duplicate RMAs per serial.
prime-forwarder: Warranty follows serial; we'll attach same RMA reference across split AWBs. Depot photos + signed manifest are sufficient to initiate RMA claiming.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-5017 linked to AWB 620-3344556. Status: awaiting depot photos.
zoe-logistics: Uploading serials now: ```serials: [H100-XY1001,H100-XY1002,H100-XY1003,H100-XY1004,H100-XY1005,H100-XY1006,H100-XY1007,H100-XY1008,H100-XY1009]```
maria-procurement: I'll queue the €72k uplift for finance approval. If finance declines, we hold and Noah will deploy canary mitigations.
noah-sre: Canary ready. I'll pre-warm smaller instances and update routing to US pool for non-critical traffic. Policy flip ETA 12m.
zoe-logistics: Prime, if the EDI outage is on your partner side, can you request a surcharge credit if we still pay air uplift? past vendors provided partial credits.
prime-forwarder: Escalating. Partner acknowledged gateway outage and opened a surcharge dispute. Will request partial credit; cannot promise. Update in ~2-3h.
eli-ops: Legal: capture explicit signed depot attestation that photos are admissible for RMA/insurance. Add to RMA notes.
zoe-logistics: Added to RMA-5017 comments. If waiver denied, we'll execute air-split by 18:30 CET. Please prioritize photos + manifest sign-off. :thumbsup:
